cv.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER
cv.summary: 8+ years of experience delivering impactful solutions across industries like e-commerce, healthcare, and logistics. Highlights include leading the technical development at Mango as Tech Lead, implementing key integrations that boosted subscriptions and revenue at a consolidated company, and leading the transition of a mobile app from beta to production at a startup. Skilled in backend development, strategic planning, and cross-functional collaboration. Committed to delivering high-quality, results-driven systems that foster business growth while maintaining a collaborative and positive team environment.

backend.title: Backend development:
backend.description: extensive experience in backend technologies, with a strong focus on implementing SOLID principles and object-oriented programming. Proven expertise in optimizing SQL queries, implementing caching solutions, and enhancing system performance. Proficient in monitoring tools and microservices architecture. JavaScript, TypeScript, Ruby, Python, Node.js, Express, NestJS, Ruby on Rails, Strapi, Sidekiq, Laravel, REST APIs.

testing.title: Testing & CI/CD:
testing.description: expertise in Test-Driven Development (TDD), ensuring high-quality code, and implementing efficient CI/CD pipelines for smooth deployments. RSpec, Mocha, Jest, GitHub Actions, Git.

api.title: API integrations:
api.description: deep experience in designing and integrating APIs, enabling seamless communication between systems and ensuring efficient data exchange across diverse platforms.

database.title: Database management:
database.description: advanced knowledge in optimizing and managing relational and NoSQL databases to ensure performance and scalability. Prisma, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Supabase.

cloud.title: Cloud & DevOps:
cloud.description: experience in building and deploying cloud-based solutions with a focus on reliability and monitoring. AWS, GitHub Actions, Docker, Sentry, Turbo.

collaboration.title: Cross-functional collaboration:
collaboration.description: adept at working closely with product managers, marketing teams, and developers to align technical solutions with business objectives and improve market positioning.

leadership.title: Project & team leadership:
leadership.description: experience leading small teams, mentoring, and participating in recruitment. Proficient in Agile/Scrum methodologies and delivering tailored solutions in fast-paced environments.

frontend.title: Frontend & mobile development:
frontend.description: proficiency in creating seamless user experiences for web and hybrid mobile platforms. JavaScript, TypeScript, Astro, Quasar, Vue, React, React Native, Next.js, Expo, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, EAS.

experiences.description: Leading the technical and operational development team, ensuring scalable and maintainable solutions aligned with product strategy. Supervised implementation of CI/CD tools and monitoring systems to ensure platform reliability and performance.
Communicated progress, technical risks, and strategic decisions to the CTO and stakeholders effectively.

Actively involved in release planning and code reviews, maintaining high standards of code quality.

Collaborated with the team to enhance user experience (UX/UI) and resolve system-wide performance issues.
Worked closely with stakeholders to meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced startup environment, demonstrating adaptability and problem-solving skills.

experiences.description: Guiding discoveries and development in a bespoke software development venture.
